(´･ω･`)|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 19 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Normal]])}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|New fast enemy incoming!|Beginning of Wave 19 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Easy Mode|Beginner's]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Bolt''' is a very fast [[Enemies|enemy]] that appears in [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode and [[Challenge Trials]]. It is noticeably faster than most of the enemies that have spawned previously, or will subsequently, in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode. It also has slightly more health than the [[Armored]], though it lacks its defense. In [[Casual Mode|Casual]] mode, the [[Grave Digger]] can spawn the '''Bolt''' with its ''Summon'' ability. The '''Bolt''' can also be spawned from the [[Mystery]] upon its death in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode. The '''Bolt''' is replaced by the [[Arrow]] in [[Headache Headquarters]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |{{Tabber |Current |The current '''Bolt''' has a glowing bright yellow skin color and a desaturated yellow torso and legs. It wears a grey vest on its body with a glowing yellow lightning bolt emblem and a yellow stripe going down the middle. The front side of the vest has smaller yellow stripes leading up towards the backside. The backside of the vest has an exposed compartment with a red switch and two batteries labeled "Durablox" embedded into a battery compartment. It also has two vents on the backside that emit a yellow aura. It constantly emits sparking particles. It plays a thunder striking sound on death. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Bolt''' had glowing bright yellow skin and a dark yellow torso and legs. It had an energy pack on its back, a glowing desaturated yellow lightning bolt on its chest and desaturated yellow veins could be seen on its body. It also emitted yellow particles as it runs. It played a thunder sound on death. }} |Legacy |{{Tabber |Current |The current version of the legacy '''Bolt''' is smaller than most of the enemies in the game. It has neon sky blue skin, and a diamond-plated torso and legs. There is a blue lightning bolt symbol on its torso and it wears grey diamond-plated armbands. When it runs, it has a sprinting animation. Blue sparks come out from its torso and arms. It played a popping sound on death. |Version 2 |The second version of the legacy '''Bolt''' was identical to its third version, except it had a sad face. |Version 1 |The first version of legacy '''Bolt''' had neon blue skin, a dark grey torso and legs with a lightning bolt symbol on its torso. It also wore grey diamond-plated armbands. Blue sparks were emitted from its head. When running, its animation was similar to that of a Naruto Run. }} }} ==Strategy== *Early game towers like the [[Soldier]], [[Militant]], [[Biologist]], [[Assassin]] or [[Cowboy]] can be used to deal with this quite well. **DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Hunter]] or [[Crook Boss]] can also be effective, though they are not necessary. *Stalling towers like the [[Freezer]], [[Electroshocker]], [[Brawler]] or [[Warden]] can be used to stall the '''Bolt'''. **Do note that most of such towers deal enough DPS to be able to also clear out '''Bolts''' on their own. *'''Bolts''' mostly appear in groups, so splash damage towers like the [[Rocketeer]] and [[Mortar]] are fairly effective. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants (Modern)}} BoltV4.png|First version (24 February 2024 – 25 September 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants (Legacy)}} NewBolt.png|Second version (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) Bolt-0.png|First version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Animations (Modern)}} BoltWalk.gif|Walking animation (25 September 2024 – Present) BoltDeath.gif|Death animation (Unused) {{GalleryHeader|Animations (Legacy)}} LegacyBoltWalk.gif|Walking animation (8 May 2021 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants (Modern)}} DefHacker1Bolt.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2Bolt.png|Overclock variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants (Modern)}} CorpseBolt.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants (Legacy)}} CorpseLegacyBolt.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V1.33.0PromotionalImage.png|'''Bolt''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} V1.33Thumbnail.png|'''Bolt''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tesla Tower Trailer - LegacyBoltIconIG.png|Legacy '''Bolt''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Bolt''' used to have a very similar appearance to the [[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]] from [[Polluted Wasteland II]], with only color changes separating them. **The '''Bolt''' and [[Shock]] also used to be very similar in appearance with only material and color changes separating them. *The '''Bolt''' was formerly one of the smallest enemies in the game. *The word "Durablox" written on the batteries is a portmanteau of Duracell, which is a real-life battery brand, and Roblox. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''13 October 2019''' -
